learner.name: Course recommendations are unavailable
learner.description: The learning workspace and all core course activities are healthy, but the optional course recommendations experience reports that it is unavailable.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate manually. No automated incident is expected until you complete the alert, skill, custom-agent, and response-plan exercise.

learner.name: Quiz and API responses are slow
learner.description: Learners can still open quizzes and assessments, but response times are consistently elevated enough to interrupt normal course work.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore normal quiz response times. Then check recovery here.

learner.name: Quiz launch is failing — Scenario 1
learner.description: Learners can open the site, but attempts to begin a quiz fail consistently.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore quiz launch. Then check recovery here.

learner.name: Quiz launch is failing — Scenario 2
learner.description: Learners reach the site, but quiz requests return an error instead of opening the activity.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore quiz launch. Then check recovery here.

learner.name: Quiz launch is failing — Scenario 3
learner.description: Learners can browse course content, but the quiz activity is unavailable when they try to begin.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore quiz launch. Then check recovery here.

learner.name: Quiz search responses are slow
learner.description: Learners can open quiz activities, but question lookup and search responses take long enough to disrupt normal work.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore normal response times. Then check recovery here.

learner.name: Quiz requests fail intermittently
learner.description: Learners can sometimes begin a quiz, but repeated attempts alternate between successful responses and temporary failures.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore reliable quiz access. Then check recovery here.

learner.name: Quiz requests fail consistently
learner.description: Learners can browse course information, but every attempt to open a quiz returns a temporary service error.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore quiz access. Then check recovery here.

learner.name: Grade reports are missing
learner.description: Recent grade and completion reports stop appearing even though learners can continue using course activities.
learner.recoveryGuidance: Ask the selected SRE Agent to investigate the active alert and restore recent report output. Then check recovery here.
